p2_mustfail_control.interpretation: shuffled continuation must NOT train (real-data ingredient)

p3_learning_curve.interpretation: held-out precision must MOVE with more REAL mining data

oracle_ceiling_guard.note: handed-gold winner; must NOT trivially hit ~1.000 (G2); real ceiling honestly < 1.000 (G4)

crlb_n/a: extraction-precision metric; no quantitative noise floor (relative rival prediction err)
error_signal_rationale: G1: err = residual_magnitude(REAL next-sentence content bundle, predict(W, parse_key)). The target is the ACTUAL subsequent text (next n_next same-file sentences), NOT a WordNet/VerbNet oracle, NOT gold, NOT self-generated. This is the exact fix for the SCV null (atom 29360): oracle-scored static selector -> real-data predictive loop.
claim_ceiling: SELF-SUPERVISED w.r.t. parse-labels AND w.r.t. the scoring signal (real corpus continuation; no curated oracle). content vectors are RANDOM (no pretrained semantics) so the predictive signal is learned by W from REAL transitions. GloVe enters ONLY the shared base teacher (identical across all arms), NOT the tested contrast signal. Ceiling < 1.000 on real data (G4). NOT a claim of learned world-knowledge -- a claim that a rival-vs-real-data predictive CONTRAST is a genuine learning signal where a static oracle selector was not.

gold_meta_independence.corpus: McGuffey Third Reader (PG#14766, public domain), lessons L04,L05,L07,L08,L09,L10,L12 (clean narrative prose; L06 title-only + L11 blacksmith poem excluded).
gold_meta_independence.independence: Annotated by reading the raw McGuffey sentence text and writing the TRUE argument structure per sentence. The point of this gold is to mark, per verb-INSTANCE, whether it takes a direct affected/created/perceived PATIENT (pos) or takes NO direct patient (nopat: intransitive-motion / cognition-clausal / oblique-perception / report / copular / aspectual). The reader's extraction output was used ONLY to key which sentence-ids exist; the pos/nopat argument-structure judgments are the annotator's own reading of the text (ground truth), independent of what the reader extracted. Keyed to deterministic sentence ids (split_sents on the lessons).
gold_meta_independence.standard: pos relation = (v_lemma, agent_head, patient_head) where an AGENT acts on / creates / perceives a distinct PATIENT/THEME ENTITY. Heads are surface tokens (pronouns kept). nopat instance = (v_lemma, agent_head) for a verb occurrence that licenses NO direct patient: intransitive self-motion (come/go/sit/stand/fall/run/walk/spring/leap/creep/swim), cognition/clausal-complement (think/know/wonder/mean/wish/hope/believe/see-that/find-that/fear/suppose/choose/prefer/intend/learn), oblique/perception-AT (look-at/tread-on/struggle-against/meddle-with/fire-on/reach-for/inquire-about), report/speech (say/said/cry[exclaim]/ask/answer/retort/tell[recipient+clause]/call[summon]/exclaim/speak), aspectual (begin/commence/try/continue-of-motion), copular/light-idiom (do-no-harm/get-finished). A verb-instance is in EXACTLY one of pos or nopat (or absent if not annotated). EXCLUDED entirely (neither): passives with no expressed agent, bare copulas, embedded infinitive objects, gerund-internal objects, quantifier-only 'nothing/nobody' patients, ambiguous idioms.
gold_meta_independence.usage: PRIMARY precision/recall over pos (v_lemma, patient) patient-level. SUBCAT TRUE-NEGATIVE: over nopat verb-instances the reader mis-attached a patient to, does an arm SUPPRESS the wrong patient (correct) vs keep it (subcat FP). WITHIN-FRAME FP: reader keeps a wrong patient on a verb whose pos set is non-empty. refs = agent coref surfaces for the lenient-agent triple metric only.
gold_meta_independence.caveat: SINGLE-ANNOTATOR gold; the pos-vs-nopat boundary involves judgment calls (rub-against/knit-forehead/nod-head counted as pos contact/body-part per the sibling v1 gold convention; look-at/tread-on/struggle-against counted nopat oblique). Full gold + full reader output + all matches are reported in metrics so a VET can independently re-annotate the same sentences and recompute.
gold_meta_independence.characters: Herbert(he/his/him), Joe(he/him), papa/Mr.Rose(he), Hetty(she/her), pussy=cat(she/her/it), Charles(he/him), James(he/him), Frank(he/him), the gardener(he), mother/mamma(she/her), father(he), the castle/block/kite/hut(it).
